newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil steady, but quiet except barges.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil steady, but quiet except barges.

text.p: Cracked fuel oil was steady in NWE with most players still out of the market.
"There's little reason for any change in prices," said one dealer.

The barge market was reasonably active with up to 15,000 tonnes of bunker interest seen. A prompt loading high sulphur barge was done at $111 a tonne fob ARA and a second half January barge was concluded at $115 a tonne.
Dealers said the contango was in part caused by heavy selling earlier in the week by a major refiner who had to shift material because of problems at their Dutch refinery.
The cargo market was much quieter for both high and low sulphur fuel.
"There are still a lot of people out and I don't expect much to be done until next week," said one trader at a major.
Those players who were in the market said crude looked stronger following U.S data showing a draw in stocks.
